summary: Overlapping avatars in one row, with an optional cap that collapses the rest into a +N avatar.

props.name: overlap
props.description: How far each avatar sits over the one before it. `none` spaces them normally.

props.name: max
props.description: Show at most this many avatars, then one more reading `+N` for the rest. Unset shows every avatar you pass.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the `+N` avatar only. The avatars you pass carry their own `size`.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged with the stack's own classes, so a utility you pass wins.
